payload.rationale: The document reproduces a production failure where a ## heading arrives without an id field and the pipeline must not crash but must produce a valid slug. This maps directly onto three graph nodes already witnessed from the same source: the MemoryPipeline strata (robust ingestion), the Narrative_DeterministicFallbackEnsuresArtifactPersistence (how the pipeline ensures safe deterministic identity when explicit IDs are missing), and the unplaced Position_PipelineSlugGenerationOnMissingId (the position on resolving/persisting artifact identity without an explicit id). I expanded all three to witness depth to surface the two expressions — the plain-assertion that content was submitted without an id field, and the commitment-marker decision that the pipeline must produce a slug via LLM id-gen or deterministic slugify fallback and commit successfully. Actor_XenaExpertgh is included as the voice behind both expressions. I deliberately did not expand ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst or ns__Actor_XenaGithubber — the diagnostic-first methodology and the alternate actor variant are unrelated to slug generation and pipeline identity resolution.
